invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of execute(), which should return non-null metadata upon successful rollback execution.
The rollbackInstantTime is passed to an action executor and is likely required for rollback; a null value might be invalid.
The commitInstant is required to identify which commit to roll back, and is used directly in the rollback process.
The method returns a HoodieRollbackMetadata object.
The result object is exactly an instance of HoodieRollbackMetadata as constructed and returned by the method.
